data.name: ExtractMethodName_Empty
data.value: The new procedure needs a name.

data.name: ExtractMethodName_NotAnIdentifier
data.value: '{0}' is not a name: a name is a letter, then letters, digits and underscores.

data.name: ExtractMethodName_Reserved
data.value: '{0}' is a keyword of the language: nothing can be named '{0}'.

data.name: ExtractMethodName_TooLong
data.value: A name is at most {3} characters long.

data.name: ExtractMethodName_Rebinds
data.value: '{0}' at {2} means {1}: it would mean the new procedure instead.

data.name: ExtractMethodName_Shadows
data.value: '{0}' is also {1}, which the new procedure hides in this module.
